blocks.content: The revamped India Code Portal was launched on 13 August 2026 at Kartavya Bhavan 2 in New Delhi by Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Law and Justice Arjun Ram Meghwal. The portal provides digital access to the Constitution, Central Acts, and other legislative documents for citizens, legal professionals, researchers, and government departments.

items: The Constitution of India came into force on 26 January 1950.
The Eighth Schedule of the Constitution originally listed 14 languages and now includes 22 languages.
The National Informatics Centre was established in 1976 and functions under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
The e-Gazette is the digital version of the Gazette of India, which publishes official government notifications and legal instruments.
